messages.subject: Board minute for tomorrow — Whitford settlement
messages.plaintextBody:
Miriam — draft board minute for tomorrow attached, authorising settlement up to the £190k ceiling and delegating execution to any one director or the Company Secretary. The agreed number is £185k, comfortably inside the authority. Let me know if you want any changes before the meeting.

Tom

--
Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
tom.gallagher@whitfieldcarter.com
